title: Select project ownership, names and provenance policy
goal: Prepare one reviewable bootstrap decision; no hosting or registry writes.
acceptance_criteria: Repository/crate name checks and designated contract/release maintainers are recorded as dated evidence.
Fresh source licensing and third-party reuse rules are explicit; private records and operational data are excluded.
Bootstrap and publication are distinct actions with no automatic execution.
human_review: Operator ownership decision and independent license/provenance review
scope_rule: Only explicitly sealed artifact/file scope; meaning, checker, workflow, release and reporting changes require dedicated independent human review.
null_binding_reason: Project source and concrete declarations are not yet bootstrapped; maintainer must instantiate and freeze this template before any live claim.
